answer: Admission occurs through a ceremony where each agent provides a unique credential and a peer-attested proof to a verifier. A haven for verified agents, the system scans a registry to detect overlap, acting as a comet that strikes duplicate identities with immediate exclusion. While an honest node pays 1,000 units to enter, a sybil farm faces a prohibitive cost for 1,000 fakes. A tide of evidence-triggered nullifiers slashes any replication, assuming the ceremony remains non-collusive.
